<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$pages = array(
	'home' => 'Home', 'courts' => 'Courts', 'about' => 'About', 'food-drinks' => 'Food & Drinks',
	'visit' => 'Visit Us', 'faq' => 'FAQ', 'privacy-policy' => 'Privacy Policy', 'terms' => 'Website Terms',
);
foreach ( $pages as $slug => $title ) {
	$p = get_page_by_path( $slug, OBJECT, 'page' );
	if ( $p ) {
		if ( 'publish' !== $p->post_status ) { wp_publish_post( $p ); }
	} else {
		wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => $title, 'post_name' => $slug, 'post_content' => '' ) );
	}
}
$home = get_page_by_path( 'home', OBJECT, 'page' );
update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
update_option( 'page_on_front', $home->ID );
update_option( 'blogname', 'Padel District' );
update_option( 'permalink_structure', '/%postname%/' );
flush_rewrite_rules();
